lead.text: *Reading the book changes little. Doing this program changes a lot.*

blocks.text: Thirty days. Each day: one real problem, one observation, one small decision, one useful action, one reflection.
Time budget: 20 minutes per day. Do it before or after work — not during. This is not billable. This is you, training yourself.

items: PROBLEM — pick one real problem to work on today.
OBSERVE — notice something you would normally miss.
DECIDE — make one small decision, using a framework.
REFLECT — one sentence in your notebook at end of day.

blocks.text: Every week, one bigger question: what did reality teach me?

rows: Practice the 4-Breath Reset three times today, on genuine triggers.
At 12pm and 6pm, name the specific emotion. Not 'fine.'
Log every interruption in one 90-minute block.
Get 10 minutes of morning outdoor light. No screens after 10pm.
Pick one habit. Do only its 2-minute version. Nothing more.
Name the flavor of one thing you've been avoiding. Take one small step.
What did I notice about my baseline? What changed?
Take one thing on your task list. Write the 5-level problem statement.
Tag every sentence in one important message you received.
Notice one of your own biases in real time. Write it down.
In one meeting, ask a question from the 7-question ladder.
Take one industry belief you hold. Ask why. Investigate one assumption.
Publicly, honestly, on one small thing. 'In light of X, I've updated.'
Where is my thinking sharper? Where is it still sloppy?
Search, compare, verify. Chase one claim back to primary source.
Send one well-designed help request today.
Apply the sequence to one thing you're stuck on.
One real conversation. Mirror, reflect, wait.
One email you were going to write casually — do it in PREP.
What did I learn that I couldn't have learned by reading?
Set your Top Three. Book them. Defend them.
Pick a task you botch. Retrospectively build its checklist.
Delegate one thing properly. Include reverse brief.
Draw the current state of one process. Interview one person who runs it.
Save 3 AI prompts that worked exceptionally well this month.
Complete all six if not already done. Set aside 3 hours.
What system am I now running that I wasn't running a month ago?
Take one open decision. Run all seven questions. Sleep on it.
Answer: in 10 years, what will I wish I had done more of this year? What less? What is one 90-day change I will make as a result?

blocks.text: Sit for 30 minutes at the end. Answer:

items: What did reality teach me over these 30 days?
Where was I wrong about myself?
What is the ONE thing I will continue past day 30?

blocks.text: Then close the program — and start the next 30 days on that one thing.
*“Thirty days won't finish you. Thirty days will start you.”*
